findings.description: __aexit__ calls self.__exit__ with (None, None, None) instead of forwarding exc_type, exc_value and traceback, so exception information is dropped.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception is raised inside an `async with` attempt block. The sync __exit__ is told no exception occurred, so it records the attempt result as None (success) and the retry logic treats the failed attempt as succeeded. Impact: the exception is not recorded and retries do not occur; the failure is silently wrong.
